Name: (CR) Kisaa's Blossom Crest Farm
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][i][size=3]﻿﻿Welcome to the [b]Blossom Crest Farm:[/b] A flowery hilltop and valley farm bisected by a river. The rough terrain may be difficult to traverse, but if you climb high enough, you might be rewarded by a beautiful view.[/size][/i][/center]

[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Farm added through AdditionalFarms: [/b]Does NOT replace any Vanilla farms and is selectable from the farm type menu on starting a new save.[/*]
[*][b]Custom starter giftbox items: [/b]Choose before starting a new save![/*]
[*][b]Minecart network: [/b]Unlock through progression to make traversal around the farm easier![/*]
[*][b]Diggable grass tiles: [/b]There are designated crop plots prepared, but feel free to dig in anywhere![/*]
[*][b]Custom fish/crab pot catch pool: [/b]Fish for mountain fish in the rivers.[/*]
[*][b]Custom quarry area and respawning boulders: [/b]If you don't want this, [i][b]delete the [FTM] CR Blossom Crest Farm folder.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][b]Custom starter farmhouse layout[/b][/*]
[*][b]Supports 8-person multiplayer![/b][/*]
[*][b]Farm customization[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=3]Want to adjust these features to your liking? You can do it all in the mod config! Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easier in-game customization.[/size]

[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Starter Gift: [/b]Changes stuff you get from the starter gift box.[/*]
[*][b]Available options:[/b] Farmer (15x Parsnip Seeds), Miner (10x Cherry Bombs, 1x Furnace), Canner (10x Bean Starters, 5x Preserve Jars).[/*]
[*][b]﻿Grassy West Hill: [/b]Changes terrain on the west hill from dirt to grass (does not affect diggability).[/*]
[*][b]﻿Grassy East Hill: [/b]Changes terrain on the east hill from dirt to grass (does not affect diggability).[/*]
[*][b]West Hill Fences: [/b]Toggles preplaced fences on the west hill.[/*]
[*][b]Summit Hill Fences: [/b]Toggles preplaced fences on the summit hill.[/*]
[*][b]Southwest Pond: [/b]Toggles the pond on the farm's southwest area.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, etc.
[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue, Eemie, etc.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets﻿[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Blossom Crest Farm" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Have fun![/*]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Do not install this mod on an existing save file, as it will result in wrong debris/object/building spawns.[/*]
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3]As usual please report any bugs here on Nexus, or you can reach out to me (crystalinerose) in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley Discord[/url]﻿ for a faster response.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod! Special thanks to rokugin and Esca for relieving my headache with the Quarry Situation.

[b][size=3][i]Mods used in screenshots:﻿[/i][/size]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url]﻿[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage (Unofficial)[/url]﻿[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5168]Wildflower Grass[/url]﻿[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿[/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20710]Pet Bowl Recolor[/url][/size][/b][/*]
[/list]
